name: jumbo-reauthor
description: TEMPLATE (f): tpl-hdb-jumbo re-authored — every room reachable (was 7 sealed groups), Common Bath moved out of the master enclosure to the corridor, master ensuite walled off, bedrooms 4/5 divided, master + bedroom 3 given their own windows. Asserts the geometry (master can take a bed, Common Bath clear of the master, door count) and screenshots the 2D plan and the 3D shell. Furnishing is asserted by unit tests instead — replaceFloorPlan re-homes existing items rather than running the arranger.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: assert-master-fits-a-bed
steps.eval: (()=>{const m=window.__store.getState().floorPlan.rooms.find(r=>r.id==='jb-master'); const shortest=Math.min(m.width,m.depth); const longest=Math.max(m.width,m.depth); if(longest<2.2) throw new Error('master longest side '+longest+' m cannot take a 2.0 m bed'); return m.width+' x '+m.depth})()

steps.name: assert-every-room-reachable
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState().floorPlan; const need=['jb-kit','jb-yard','jb-shelter','jb-cbath','jb-master','jb-mbath','jb-bed4','jb-bed5']; const missingDoors=need.filter(id=>{const r=s.rooms.find(x=>x.id===id); return !r}); if(missingDoors.length) throw new Error('missing rooms: '+missingDoors); const doors=s.openings.filter(o=>o.kind==='door').length; if(doors<13) throw new Error('only '+doors+' doors; the sealed-wing fix needs 14'); return doors+' doors'})()

steps.name: assert-cbath-outside-master
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState(); const cb=s.floorPlan.rooms.find(r=>r.id==='jb-cbath'); const m=s.floorPlan.rooms.find(r=>r.id==='jb-master'); const overlap=cb.origin[0]<m.origin[0]+m.width&&cb.origin[0]+cb.width>m.origin[0]&&cb.origin[1]<m.origin[1]+m.depth&&cb.origin[1]+cb.depth>m.origin[1]; if(overlap) throw new Error('Common Bath still overlaps the master'); return 'cbath at '+cb.origin.join(',')})()
